title: La Matanza: Army Massacres Peasant Uprising
reason: Confirmed: January 1932 Pipil/communist-led rebellion, Hernandez Martinez ordered reprisals, 10,000-40,000 killed, majority Pipil-speaking population exterminated.

title: General Strike Ousts Military Dictator Martínez
reason: Confirmed: April 1944 civic/student strike forced Martinez resignation after ruling since 1931.

title: New Constitution and Reformist Military Government
reason: Confirmed: 1950 constitution adopted, Oscar Osorio took power, ISSS created, developmentalist reforms.

title: 5 de Noviembre Hydroelectric Dam Construction Begins
reason: Dam exists on Lempa River under Osorio's industrialization program. Specific 1952 start / 1954 completion dates not independently confirmed but consistent with sources; no contradicting evidence found.

title: Central American Common Market Treaty Signed
reason: Confirmed: General Treaty on Central American Economic Integration signed 1960, CACM formed with Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua.

title: Partido de Conciliación Nacional Founded as Military Party
reason: Confirmed: PCN founded 1961 as military-backed civilian facade, dominated elections through fraud until 1979.

title: PDC Wins San Salvador: Duarte Elected Mayor
reason: Confirmed: Duarte won San Salvador mayorship in 1964 municipal elections.

title: ORDEN Rural Paramilitary Intelligence Network Created
reason: Confirmed: ORDEN established as rural paramilitary/intelligence network, tens of thousands of informants, instrument of social control.

title: Football War with Honduras
reason: Confirmed: El Salvador invaded Honduras July 14 1969, four-day war, OAS ceasefire July 18, shattered CACM, expelled 300,000+ Salvadoran migrants.

title: Duarte's Presidential Election Victory Stolen by Military Fraud
reason: Confirmed: Duarte appeared to win, military awarded victory to Arturo Molina, Duarte arrested, tortured, exiled.

title: FPL Armed Organization Founded and University Occupied
reason: Confirmed: FPL founded by Cayetano Carpio, University of El Salvador occupied/closed same period.

title: University Students Massacred at National Protest
reason: Confirmed: July 30 1975, National Guard/armed forces opened fire on students protesting Miss Universe pageant spending, multiple killed. Death toll disputed (dozens to over 100), not 'over a dozen' as stated — description is conservative but not materially wrong.

title: Elite Defeats Molina's Agrarian Transformation Proposal
reason: Confirmed: Molina proposed modest agrarian reform, ANEP-led elite campaign forced abandonment.

title: Archbishop Romero Appointed Amid Escalating Repression
reason: Confirmed: Romero appointed February 1977, radicalized after Father Rutilio Grande assassination, Sunday homilies on Catholic radio.

title: Fraudulent Presidential Election and Plaza Libertad Massacre
reason: Confirmed: February 20 1977 election fraudulently awarded to Carlos Humberto Romero over Ernesto Claramount. Plaza Libertad protest violently dispersed, dozens to hundreds killed.

title: Reformist Military Coup Overthrows Romero
reason: Confirmed: October 1979 coup overthrew President Carlos Humberto Romero, civilian members resigned citing ongoing death squad killings.

title: Archbishop Romero Assassinated at the Altar
reason: Confirmed: Shot March 24 1980 while celebrating mass. UN Truth Commission: D'Aubuisson ordered assassination. Canonized October 2018.

title: FMLN Formed from Five Guerrilla Organizations
reason: Confirmed: FMLN formally constituted October 10 1980 from five organizations (FPL, ERP, RN, PCS, PRTC).

title: Four U.S. Churchwomen Murdered by National Guard
reason: Confirmed: Four American churchwomen abducted, raped, murdered by National Guard soldiers December 1980.

title: El Mozote Massacre: Over 800 Civilians Killed
reason: Confirmed: Atlacatl Battalion massacred 811+ civilians in December 1981 in Morazan, including 533 children. UN forensics confirmed 1992.

title: Reagan Administration Dramatically Escalates Military Aid
reason: Confirmed: Reagan framed conflict as Cold War proxy, dramatically escalated military aid, U.S. advisors expanded Salvadoran army.

title: D'Aubuisson Chairs Constituent Assembly; ARENA Founded
reason: Confirmed: March 1982 constituent assembly elections, D'Aubuisson chaired assembly, ARENA represented hardline interests.

title: Duarte Wins Presidential Election with U.S. Support
reason: Confirmed: Duarte won May 1984 runoff against D'Aubuisson, met FMLN at La Palma for first direct negotiations.

title: Major Earthquake Devastates San Salvador
reason: Confirmed: October 10 1986 earthquake, magnitude ~5.7, 1,000-1,500 killed, 200,000 homeless.

title: Arias Peace Plan: Esquipulas II Accords Signed
reason: Confirmed: Esquipulas II signed August 1987, brokered by Oscar Arias, Arias received Nobel Peace Prize.

title: ARENA's Alfredo Cristiani Wins Presidential Election
reason: Confirmed: Cristiani won March 1989. FMLN November offensive briefly occupied wealthy San Salvador neighborhoods.

title: Jesuit Priests Murdered at UCA by Atlacatl Battalion
reason: Confirmed: November 16 1989, six Jesuits + housekeeper + daughter murdered by Atlacatl Battalion. UN Truth Commission: General Rene Emilio Ponce ordered killings.

title: UN-Mediated Peace Talks Begin in Geneva
reason: Confirmed: UN-mediated talks opened April 1990 in Geneva, human rights agreement signed July, ONUSAL established.

title: Chapultepec Peace Accords End Twelve-Year Civil War
reason: Confirmed: Peace Accords signed January 16 1992 at Chapultepec Castle, Mexico City. Ceasefire February 1 1992. War killed 70,000-80,000.

title: UN Truth Commission 'From Madness to Hope' Released
reason: Confirmed: Report attributed 85% of violations to government/affiliated forces, blanket amnesty law passed days after release.

title: First Post-War Elections: ARENA Retains Presidency
reason: Confirmed: March-April 1994 elections, ARENA's Calderon Sol defeated FMLN's Zamora in runoff.

title: Gang Crisis Emerges: MS-13 and Barrio 18 Establish Footholds
reason: Confirmed: MS-13 and Barrio 18 established territorial control in mid-1990s driven by US deportation policies returning LA gang members.

title: U.S. Deportation Policy Accelerates Gang Transplantation
reason: Confirmed: IIRIRA 1996 resulted in mass deportations of Salvadorans with criminal records, transplanting gang structures into post-war society.

title: FMLN Wins San Salvador Mayoralty
reason: Confirmed: FMLN won San Salvador in 1997 municipal elections, Hector Silva became first FMLN mayor.

title: Hurricane Mitch Causes Widespread Flooding
reason: Confirmed: Hurricane Mitch October 1998, significant flooding/landslides in El Salvador, hundreds killed, hundreds of millions in damages.

title: Two Major Earthquakes Kill Over 1,000
reason: Confirmed: January and February 2001 earthquakes (7.7 and 6.6 magnitude), 1,000+ killed, 150,000 homeless, Las Colinas landslide.

title: Dollarization: U.S. Dollar Becomes Sole Legal Tender
reason: Confirmed: Monetary Integration Law took effect January 1 2001, colón replaced by USD at 8.75 colones fixed rate.

title: Remittances Exceed $2 Billion, Surpassing All Exports
reason: Confirmed: Remittances exceeded $2B circa 2002, surpassing export earnings, structurally central to economy.

title: Mano Dura Anti-Gang Law Enacted
reason: Confirmed: Mano Dura signed by Flores 2003, Super Mano Dura by Saca 2004. Mass arrests failed to reduce homicides; strengthened gang discipline.

title: CAFTA-DR Free Trade Agreement Signed with United States
reason: Confirmed: CAFTA-DR signed May 2004, ratified over agricultural opposition.

title: FMLN's Mauricio Funes Wins Presidency, Ending ARENA Rule
reason: Confirmed: Funes won March 2009 with 51.3%, ending 20 years of ARENA rule, first peaceful left-right transfer of power.

title: Homicide Rate Reaches Crisis Levels; Gang Truce Explored
reason: Confirmed: Homicide rate reached ~70/100,000, gang truce groundwork laid, massive displacement and emigration.

title: Government-Brokered Gang Truce Cuts Homicides Dramatically
reason: Confirmed: Gang truce March 2012, homicides fell from 14+/day to under 5. Collapsed 2013-2014, homicides then surged.

title: Child Migration Crisis: Tens of Thousands Flee Gang Violence
reason: Confirmed: 2014 unaccompanied child migration crisis, gang violence primary driver, 200,000+ internally displaced by 2015.

title: Sánchez Cerén Wins Narrow Runoff; Amnesty Law Struck Down
reason: Confirmed: Sanchez Ceren won March 2014 runoff by <1%. Constitutional Court struck down 1993 amnesty law same year.

title: Homicide Rate Reaches 103 Per 100,000: World's Highest
reason: Confirmed: 103/100,000 homicide rate in 2015, highest in world outside active war zones. Supreme Court classified MS-13/Barrio 18 as terrorist organizations.

title: Former President Tony Saca Arrested for Embezzlement
reason: Confirmed: Saca arrested 2016, convicted September 2018, sentenced to 10 years. Embezzlement of $300M+ confirmed.

title: El Salvador First Country to Ban All Metal Mining
reason: Confirmed: Legislative Assembly voted 69-0 to ban all metallic mining. First country in world to do so. Entered force June 2 2017.

title: Nayib Bukele Wins Presidency, Breaking ARENA-FMLN Duopoly
reason: Confirmed: Bukele won February 2019 election in first round with 53%, defeating both ARENA and FMLN. Inaugurated June 1 2019.

title: Bukele Enters Legislature with Armed Soldiers to Pressure Lawmakers
reason: YEAR ERROR: This event occurred on February 9, 2020 (known as '9F' / '2020 Salvadoran political crisis'), not 2019. Bukele entered the assembly chamber with 40 soldiers to pressure approval of a $109M security loan. Factual description is accurate but year is wrong by 1.

title: COVID-19 Pandemic: Strict Lockdown and Economic Contraction
reason: Confirmed: El Salvador implemented strict military-enforced lockdowns, Supreme Court clashes over legality, ~8% GDP contraction.

title: Nuevas Ideas Wins Supermajority; Court and AG Removed
reason: Confirmed: Nuevas Ideas won 56/84 seats in February 2021. New assembly fired all 5 Constitutional Court justices and AG on first day (May 1 2021). Packed court later ruled Bukele eligible for re-election.

title: El Salvador Adopts Bitcoin as Legal Tender
reason: Confirmed: Bitcoin Law passed June 9 2021 with 62/84 votes. Effective September 7 2021. Chivo wallet launched with $30 per citizen. Technical problems and street protests followed.

title: State of Exception Declared; Mass Arrests of Gang Members Begin
reason: Confirmed: State of exception declared March 27 2022 after 87 gang killings over weekend. 50,000+ arrested in first year. Homicides dropped from 1,147 (2021) to 496 (2022). Human rights orgs documented arbitrary detentions, torture, deaths in custody.

title: CECOT Mega-Prison Announced
reason: Confirmed: CECOT announced and built, designed for 40,000 inmates, became globally recognized symbol of mass incarceration model.

title: IMF Warns on Bitcoin Risks; Loan Negotiations Stall
reason: Confirmed: IMF and World Bank repeatedly warned on Bitcoin risks throughout 2022, complicating loan negotiations.

title: State of Exception Extended Indefinitely; Over 200 Custody Deaths
reason: Confirmed: State of exception extended repeatedly through 2023. 200+ custody deaths documented by human rights organizations. Official homicides fell to among Western Hemisphere's lowest.

title: Bitcoin De Facto Demoted: Acceptance Made Voluntary
reason: YEAR ERROR / MATERIAL INACCURACY: The formal Bitcoin law amendment making acceptance voluntary was passed by the Legislative Assembly on January 29, 2025 (55-2 vote), effective May 1 2025 — as a condition of the December 2024 IMF deal. No formal legal change occurred in 2023. The description conflates IMF pressure building in 2023 with the actual 2025 legal amendment.

title: Bukele Re-elected with 84.65% of Vote
reason: Confirmed: Bukele won February 4 2024 with ~84% (83.14% at 70% count). ARENA and FMLN each received under 7%. Historic margin.

title: El Salvador Signs $1.4 Billion IMF Deal with Bitcoin Concessions
reason: Confirmed: IMF staff-level agreement December 2024 for $1.4B extended fund facility. Bitcoin acceptance to be made voluntary, public sector Bitcoin activity confined, Chivo wallet to be wound down.

title: El Salvador's Incarceration Rate Becomes World's Highest
reason: Confirmed: Total detainees under crackdown surpassed 84,000+, producing world's highest incarceration rate. Domestic approval for security policy remained above 80%.
